name: @theoabw/dsh-secrets
description: Consent-gated secret brokering for deepseek-harness: the agent asks for a named secret, the owner grants the session access, and the value reaches the shell as $DSH_SECRET_<handle> without ever entering the conversation.
author: Theo Wilenius <theo@tabw.dev>

scripts.test: node scripts/crypto-test.mjs && node scripts/smoke-test.mjs && node scripts/bitwarden-test.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build && pnpm run test
